select rb.role_id,rb.role_code,rb.menu_id,rb.enable_flag,rb.create_by,rb.create_date,rb.last_update_by,rb.last_update_date,rb.last_update_login, rtl.role_name,rtl.role_description,rtl.language from sys_role_b rb
join (select rm.role_id from sys_role_menu rm where rm.menu_id = #{menuId} group by rm.role_id) rma on rma.role_id = rb.role_id
join sys_role_tl rtl on rb.role_id = rtl.role_id where rtl.language = #{language}
and enable_flag = #{enableFlag}
and role_code like CONCAT( CONCAT('%',#{roleCode} ),'%')
and role_name like CONCAT( CONCAT('%',#{roleName} ),'%')
and role_description like CONCAT( CONCAT('%',#{roleDescription} ),'%')
order by rtl.role_name
